calibration_sources: Enterprise Real-Time Copilot Latency Decomposition: Parallel Guardrails, Prefix Caching & Speculative RAG Prefetch
EAGLE-3 / MTP Speculative Decoding & Cascade Routing Latency Benchmarks on vLLM/SGLang
Streaming Sliding-Window Output Moderation vs. Full-Response Blocking Guardrail Latency Analysis

workload.enterprise_scenario: Real-Time Customer Service & Live Agent Assist Copilot (500 RPS Peak, Multi-Turn Chat & Voice-to-Text, Strict Interactive SLA)
workload.target_sla: End-to-End P99 TTFT <= 400.0 ms, P99 TPOT <= 14.0 ms, 100.0% Safety Guardrail Enforcement

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统五步串行瀑布流管线 (输入审查 -> 70B改写 -> RAG检索 -> 70B生成 -> 整段输出审查)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: 5-Stage Serial Waterfall Pipeline (Serial Guardrail -> Rewrite -> RAG -> 70B -> Blocking Output Audit)
tiers.pipeline_architecture: Strictly Sequential Execution (320ms Guard + 680ms Rewrite + 290ms RAG + 1,450ms LLM + 680ms Output Check)
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for real-time customer service: 3.42s P99 delay causes severe conversational dead air and high abandonment.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 前置语义缓存短路 + 8B 小模型意图分流 (命中快，但未命中长尾仍需 1,280ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Semantic Cache Short-Circuit + 8B SLM Intent Router (1,280ms P99 on Cache Misses)
tiers.pipeline_architecture: Redis Semantic Cache (26% Hit @ 15ms) + 8B SLM Router (60% Simple Queries), Serial RAG on 40% Misses
tiers.recommended_for: Internal employee IT helpdesk chatbots where P50 < 400ms is acceptable and P99 ~ 1.3s is tolerated.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 异步并行输入护栏与检索 + 前缀缓存置顶 + 流式滑动窗口输出审查
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Async Parallel Input Guardrail & RAG + Pinned Prefix Cache + Streaming Window Output Audit
tiers.pipeline_architecture: Parallel (SLM Guardrail || Hybrid RAG = 85ms) + Pinned 8K Prefix Cache + 20-Token Sliding-Window Stream Audit
tiers.recommended_for: Standard enterprise web/mobile customer chat Copilot requiring sub-500ms response with full input/output guardrails.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 流式输入投机预取 (Speculative RAG) + 乐观并行预填充 + EAGLE-3 投机解码 (275ms 极速秒回)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Speculative Pre-EOU RAG Prefetch + Optimistic Parallel Prefill + EAGLE-3 Speculative Decoding
tiers.pipeline_architecture: Pre-EOU Partial-Input RAG Prefetch (12ms) + Optimistic Parallel Guardrail/Prefill + EAGLE-3/MTP + Cascade Router
tiers.recommended_for: Real-time voice customer service, live call-center agent assist, and IDE coding Copilots demanding P99 TTFT <= 300ms.
